skip_detail: Plaud's /auth/access-token returned status -2 'wrong account or password'. Likely cause: Plaud's web frontend uses client-side password hashing (pld_pubKey + pld_passAlgorithm localStorage keys observed during Phase 1.7 browser-sniff). The documented endpoints in sergivalverde-toolkit appear to accept plaintext but the live API rejects it. Manual JWT path (auth set-token, after logging in via web.plaud.ai and extracting from localStorage) works as the fallback.
